user.title: ekey module App
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant reaches the ekey backend.

local.title: Local connection (HTTP)
local.description: Connect to a local ekey-ha-daemon over HTTP. A token is only needed if the daemon requires one.

remote.title: Remote device (HTTPS)
remote.description: Connect to an ekey ESP32 device over HTTPS. Use the bearer token shown on the device's setup page. Leave 'Verify SSL certificate' off for the device's self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: ekey token no longer accepted
reauth_confirm.description: The backend at {host} rejected the stored API token. This normally means the token was regenerated, or the backend was factory reset. Enter the current token.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the ekey backend. Please check the host and port.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — check the API token.

menu_options.wifi_push: Push Wi-Fi credentials to the device
menu_options.wifi_reset: Reset the device's Wi-Fi (return to setup mode)

wifi_push.title: Push Wi-Fi credentials
wifi_push.description: Send new Wi-Fi settings to the ekey device via its /config API. Changing the Wi-Fi network or port reboots the device and may change its address on the network. A wrong password is verified on the device and rolled back automatically.

data.wifi_pass: Wi-Fi password (leave blank to keep current)
data.reboot_now: Reboot the device now to apply

wifi_reset.title: Reset device Wi-Fi
wifi_reset.description: This clears the stored Wi-Fi credentials and reboots the device into its setup portal, where it must be re-provisioned. The scanner pairing and API token are kept.

data.confirm: Yes, reset Wi-Fi and reboot into setup

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — check the API token.

abort.local_no_options: Wi-Fi configuration is only available for remote ekey devices, not the local daemon.

retired_entities_referenced.title: Automations still use entities that were removed
retired_entities_referenced.description:
These entities no longer exist: {entities}.

They were replaced by the **ekey** panel in the sidebar. These automations or scripts still refer to them and cannot run until they are updated: {users}.

If one of them came from the relay-pulse blueprint, re-import the current blueprint and choose your relay again — its inputs changed, so the old settings do not carry over. Note that updating the integration does **not** update a blueprint you already imported: Home Assistant keeps its own copy under `config/blueprints/automation/`.

This message clears itself on the next restart once nothing refers to them.
